description: Refined SoftMenon warm1080p timing versus initial SoftMenon, with unchanged MHC/full-paper Menon controls and measured-CFA/output-repeatability checks.

protocol.scope: Warm synchronous host-to-host on one Threadripper PRO 9985WX and RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q. AVX2 is forced runtime dispatch on this same physical CPU, not another microarchitecture. CPU copies/padding/dispatch and CUDA pageable transfers/padding/kernels/synchronization included. Independent timed lanes are shuffled; baseline and candidate use reusable allocations.
protocol.quiet: Final runs executed sequentially after all corpus validation and sanitizer processes finished.

limitations: The sub-percent GPU and forced-AVX2 differences indicate effectively unchanged performance, not evidence of a speed gain.
Forced-AVX2 Menon control was about2percent slower despite unchanged paper outputs; native MHC and Menon controls stayed within0.7percent.
These workstation timings do not establish Jetson or other CPU/GPU performance.
